notes: The source contains 295 valid coordinates under RICHI-296. Row 6, group 7 is the four-letter GDXV, at source indices 230-233.

All 296 one-loss boundaries are screened against the same ordinary-word candidate. Gaps 232 and 233 tie globally at two changes to observed coordinates. Both fill X and lead to identical full ciphertext.
Representative gap 232 is a bookkeeping choice, not a claim of unique loss placement.
